capabilities: render hidden tooltip text on hover using [visible]{tooltip} syntax
insert and wrap hover reveal syntax via commands
toggle the cursor between visible text and tooltip text
customize tooltip and visible-text colors in settings
extras: README is provided in both English and Chinese; installation is via manual download of a release zip rather than the community plugin store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to embed hover-revealed hidden text inline in notes.
summary: Inline syntax plugin that shows hidden tooltip text when hovering over marked text written as [visibleText]{tooltipText}.
